source.description: QDnCo house planning model, anchored to an owner-reported ₹40,000 premium Bengaluru residential test: 150+ leads at ₹266 CPL and 51% sales-ready, scored by the developer team. The source export and CRM cohort have not been independently reconciled.
source.googleAds: No verified QDnCo Google Ads campaign cohort is available. Google channel adjustments below are explicit planning assumptions, not measured QDnCo results or an industry benchmark.
source.qualificationDefinition: A lead is qualified when location, configuration and stated budget all match; the developer's sales team scores it.

limits.market: India planning model; Dubai campaigns are planned separately.

formula: For each month and channel: spend = monthlyBudget × channelShare × liveDayShare; CPL = baseCPL × channelCPLMultiplier × ticketCPLMultiplier; leads = spend ÷ CPL; qualified = leads × clamp(baseQualification + channelPointAdjustment); visits = qualified × qualifiedToVisitRate × followUpSpeedMultiplier; bookings = visits × visitToBookingRate × ticketVisitToBookingMultiplier.
